Pre-registered HC3 is undefined as run: apex_2025 is a one-problem competition (leverage 1), so statsmodels HC3 returns infinite SEs. The paper's b CI and p .065 are only reproduced after dropping that singleton (HC1 with the singleton gives p .060). The paper does not disclose this deviation from PREREGISTRATION.md; it does not change the inconclusive verdict.

H1u tests only d>0 within UNSOLVED. d is also positive on SOLVED (+0.06, CI [+0.01,+0.11], unregistered), and the preregistered interaction (H1) was inconclusive (CI includes 0). Abstract and contributions item 1 phrase the confirmed result as specific to problems the judge does not solve; the evidence supports 'penalty present on unsolved, larger point estimate than on solved, difference not established'. The conclusion paragraph already says this; the abstract and contribution (1) should match.

Strata and source are nearly collinear (arXiv family 84 of 90 UNSOLVED; contest 6), so within-family contrast is basically one family (+0.13, n 84 vs 56) and the contest-family estimate (+0.31 on 6 vs 81) is unusable. Stratum is also a two-attempt noisy measure; 20 of 90 pre-registered UNSOLVED were reassigned on post hoc reading. The audit was applied only to UNSOLVED replies (no symmetric check of SOLVED), though results are unchanged.

'Stating that most problems have no correct solution did not move the pooled judge's criterion' (abstract) is a non-detection: diff +0.013, CI [-0.08,+0.12], n 78; BASE was run later than the C3 PICK comparator (not a concurrent randomized arm) and also drops one PICK-prompt sentence. Word as 'no detectable shift, interval admits roughly +-0.1'. A5 has no refutation rule, so 'not confirmed' is the right label.

Criterion-shift reading is weakly supported: dJ -0.09 CI reaches -0.26 (audited strata -0.14 [-0.36,+0.07]); both procedures sit near chance on UNSOLVED (PICK J 0.03, ISO 0.12) so H4/H6 have little power to separate shift from loss of discrimination. The paper hedges this in several places; the abstract phrase 'consistent with a shift toward choosing' should stay paired with that caveat. The ISO hit definition (accept right and reject both wrong) is asymmetric with the fa definition (any accept), which mechanically depresses ISO hit when acceptance is liberal, so dhit +0.18 partly reflects the metric (acknowledged in text).

Same 227 problems feed C3, A4, A5, H3 and the sonnet repeat; Holm is within families only (disclosed).
